name: Studio II Lounge
street: 4417 N N Interstate 10 Service Rd W
description: Studio II Lounge is a lively karaoke bar known for its vibrant atmosphere and diverse entertainment options. It offers a welcoming environment with karaoke nights featuring a good sound system and a variety of song choices. The venue is also popular for its themed nights, such as ladies night and special events like goldfish races. With friendly staff, good food, and drink specials, it’s an ideal spot for both casual nights out and special celebrations. The venue maintains a clean, well-maintained space, making it a favorite local spot for fun and fellowship.
